corporation.content: In the vanguard of future industries, we commit to enhancing life's quality with our dedication, quality, and service.

product.title: MSI provides excellent products with its dominant technological prowess in the SMT industry.

desc: MSI is the trusted name in SMT. Since our founding in 1979,
MSI is creating and providing the future.
In the vanguard of future industries, we commit to enhancing life's quality with our dedication, quality, and service.

items.title: ▶ Customer Satisfaction
items.desc: We grow with customer satisfaction by providing the best products and services.

items.title: ▶ Esteem Human Culture
items.desc: We respect autonomy and creativity with the spirit of human dignity.

major.title: A talented and dedicated crew
major.desc: The MSI crew—the people who serve our clients and steward their assets with dedication, integrity, and passion—are critical to our success.

company.last: MSI, a specialist in SMT technology, is committed to sustainable management practices based on a foundation of trust with our customers and various stakeholders. By systematically responding to rapidly changing global trends, we aim to achieve sustainable growth, thereby fulfilling our corporate social responsibility.

items.title: Global Partners
items.desc: Enhancing global competitiveness together with our partners.

items.title: Government

items.title: Society

contact.title: Contact us
desc: Thank you for visiting MSI website.
Please send to your inquiry your details along with accurate email information. We will respond as quickly as possible.

service.title: Service
service.desc: From installation to everyday operation, MSI stays close to your production floor. Our principle is simple: respond fast, so your line never has to wait.

items.title: Technical Support
items.desc: Fast response to equipment errors and breakdowns by phone, remote access, or on-site visit. Line-down situations get top-priority engineer dispatch.

items.title: Preventive Maintenance
items.desc: Scheduled inspections and calibration keep your machines in top condition and reduce unexpected downtime.

items.title: Parts Supply
items.desc: Stable supply of genuine parts and consumables. In-stock items ship fast to minimize waiting time.

items.title: Installation & Training
items.desc: We handle everything from delivery and installation to test runs, and provide operator and manager training.

cta.title: Having trouble with your equipment?
cta.desc: Leave a service inquiry and our engineers will get back to you shortly.
